entries.subject: Cassini ISS frames, 2018 shape release and radial elevation
entries.finding: [PDS calibrated Cassini ISS](https://pds-rings.seti.org/cassini/iss/calibration.html) frames, the [2018 shape release and controlled camera table](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds4/cassini/saturn_satellite_shape_models_V1_0/document/telesto_document.pdf) and shape-derived radial elevation supply the delivered views.

entries.subject: Cassini ISS frame N1831469816_1 in the Monochrome lens
entries.finding: It sees Telesto as a 147° phase crescent with every sample at 79–80° incidence; its median value is 0.151 against 0.54–0.74 in the other frames, and no overlap reaches it.
entries.revisitWhen: An overlapping frame can set its level, or photometry corrects values at that incidence.

entries.subject: Published Cassini camera inventory review
entries.finding: The current package and published shape-camera inventory were reviewed. No additional frame was selected for a native-image or projection trial in this batch. The existing N1831469816 level-matching limitation remains unchanged. This is a source-selection review, not an exhaustive proof that the archive has no further coverage.
entries.revisitWhen: A new independent viewing geometry or a qualified resolution of the existing level limitation offers useful coverage.

entries.subject: Selected calibrated Cassini filter-color observations
entries.finding: IR3 N1831466962_1, GRN N1831466394_1 and UV3 N1831467236_1 supply False color through the published cameras. The 14-minute sequence spans 66–78-degree phase; green footprint edging and acquisition illumination remain explicit.

entries.subject: Independent refinement of the retained filter cameras
entries.finding: The recorded fixed-camera diagnostic did not find the six independent feature patches required for refinement or an independent feature check. The released PDS camera-table registration remains the source basis; no camera was fitted by this failed diagnostic.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent interior controls can qualify a refinement without weakening the existing criteria or replacing the published frame.

entries.subject: Cassini clear frame N1831468631_1
entries.finding: The 2016 frame extends the released-table sweep beyond N1831467723_1 using its original camera. The neighboring high-phase N1831469816_1 remains separately excluded for its unmatched low level.

entries.subject: NASA PIA07697 color composite
entries.finding: The retained survey identifies this as a perspective illustration. The selected false-color lens uses original calibrated bands and their individual released cameras instead.
entries.revisitWhen: The composited pixels have a documented camera/projection and independent coverage that supports a mapped source.
